description: This file provides utility functions for managing tenant selection in a frontend web application. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs, get/set/clear the active tenant in local storage, fetch the list of tenants from the server, and select a tenant via API calls. The implementation is tailored for a frontend environment, using fetch API, local storage, and window object, and is specific to tenant management in the application.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId(t)
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a tenant ID from various input structures, returning a string ID or null.

methods.name: getActiveTenant()
methods.description: Retrieves the active tenant ID from browser local storage, with backward compatibility fallback.

methods.name: setActiveTenant(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in local storage and cleans up legacy key.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant()
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from local storage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants()
methods.description: Fetches the list of tenants authorized for the current user via an API endpoint, handling errors and varying response shapes.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user-selection')
methods.description: Sets the active tenant on the backend through a POST API, updates local storage, and logs the action (if not in production).
